verdict:
SOUND, and integrating it makes the paper BETTER -- but only after rescoping, and it is worth about two pages inside sec:fd, not a subsection with its own priority claim.

WHAT IS REAL. The mathematics holds up under independent reconstruction. I rebuilt CV(e,s) from the printed def:fd-cv (not the route's code) and the harness confirms every clause of prop:fd-cv-values: stopping, N = 6e+s+5, a = N-5, Tw* = w*, the closed form, |Lambda| = s+2, D(G) = 2^s, Z_0 = {t0}, Z_1 = {t1}, v_0 the unique value-distinguishing vertex with gap exactly 1/D, all of G reachable from v_0. The harness's own LP-based hybrid first fires at v_0 at round 3 on CV(1,3) and 4 on CV(1,4) -- the route's numbers exactly -- and mycore's slack calculus gives M2 = 12, 24 and M2T = 11, 23 at (1,4),(2,4), also exactly. The certificate is a genuine convex chain for thm:hybrid-convex-barrier: I hand-checked the only non-automatic clause (case (f)) symbolically -- the two binding differences are u*lambda*(1-c) >= 0 and u*lambda*(1-beta_0) >= 0 -- and re-ran cert3.py at five sizes. The family is a legitimate SSG (fair coins, out-degree two), built and verified from the game, with a growth law at five measured and 27 certified sizes. No random sampling is load-bearing anywhere; the one sweep (rem:fd-cv-search) is explicitly labelled as not evidence and its negative outcome is then EXPLAINED by a proof (every design it enumerated has a gap at every controlled vertex, so lem:fd-narrow caps it at O(D)). That is the honest-negative-reporting standard this project asks for, met.

WHAT IS NEW, EXACTLY. One thing: an exponential hybrid stall whose deciding gap is COARSE. Every previous exponential stall of M5 in this development -- CC(L,m), WD(e,j,m) -- has gap 2^{-Theta(N)}, and fd.tex's cor:fd-selfread proves that under (self-reading) the hybrid fires by round D+3, so nobody could have the coarse-gap version by any of the paper's existing routes. CV gets it by separating who is slow (the vacuous pair v_1,v_2, where the polytope's width lives and there is no gap to subtract) from who must decide (the reader v_0, gap 1/D). That is a real idea, it is the counterexample the root agent's own 375-design sweep missed, and it settles rem:fd-summary(iv) negatively: the (self-reading) hypothesis of thm:fd-selfread cannot be dropped. M2T is the second new column (linear on CW, 3*2^e here).

WHAT IS NOT NEW. Everything else in the headline. M2, M4 and M6 were already settled inside the class, in the same round, by the draft sitting in the route's own directory (CW: permanent M4 stall at D = 2^s; SEP: 2^{Omega(N)} M2/M6 stall at D = 4). And the mechanism of the certificate -- a thin wedge contracting by lambda = 1-2^{-e} per round -- is thm:hybrid-lower's and thm:wedge-proved's, unchanged; what changed is where the gap is put. Say both plainly.

THE ROUTE UNDERSTATES ITSELF ONCE. Its own certificate plus thm:hybrid-sound proves the hybrid decides NO controlled vertex for k <= K, not merely v_0 -- clause (i) is blocked at v_1, v_2 by Lambda(P_k)(v_1,succ) > 0 and clause (ii) by soundness against a zero true difference. That converts a 200-round measurement into a theorem and turns the claim into the one that matters for thm:decide-one-bit: the rule makes no progress at all for 2^{Omega(N)} rounds. Put it in the theorem.

THE TRUE REMAINING GAP, sharper than the route states it. The route says the missing statement is a poly-D family the value-simulation preorder cannot see. That is softer than the truth in one direction and harder in another. Softer: by cor:fd-m7-class and thm:few-denominator the WHOLE class is decided in poly(N,D) by the rounded calculus and by the grid iteration, so no member of it can ever stall the paper's full mechanism set -- this line is now closed, and CV is its last word, not a step toward the target. Harder: the exact missing statement is "a stopping SSG carrying CV's architecture -- the polytope's width on controlled vertices with no gap, the decision at a coarse-gap reader -- in which the reader's OPTIMAL successor is not a constant-valued gadget, so that def:simorder derives no relation between the reader and either successor, and the hybrid is silent at every controlled vertex for superpolynomially many rounds"; and even that leaves M3 standing, since by thm:seed-dichotomy defeating it is the pivot's open problem. The weak spot is structural, not incidental: v_0's optimal branch H is a coin over the sinks, i.e. exactly the "variable against a constant" configuration the standing traps warn about, and it is what M1 kills at round zero (I verified: v_0 <= H is in the greatest fixed point at (1,3),(2,4),(3,4), with zero unsound pairs).

INTEGRATE: def:fd-cv, prop:fd-cv-values, lem:fd-cv-lift, thm:fd-cv-lower (strengthened to all three controlled vertices), prop:fd-cv-measured (trimmed to the two tables plus the cross-checks). REWRITE BEFORE INTEGRATING: cor:fd-cv-class (new for M5 and M2T; cite CW/SEP for M2/M4/M6; M6 measured, not proved) and rem:fd-cv (build it on WD, keep one sentence on CC). DEMOTE: lem:fd-narrow and rem:fd-narrow into a single remark after thm:fd-selfread. TRIM: rem:fd-cv-search to two sentences. Nothing here should be published as a standalone subsection with its own settlement claim.
